description:
FILED s466bd (Opus, 2026-09-03) while fixing #995.

`Pl::VarAnnotator::_tw_walk` classifies the USE of a subscript expression in
exactly one arm:

    if ($t eq \x27h_acc\x27 || $t eq \x27a_acc\x27) {
      _tw_walk($ctx, $xo, $kids->[0], 0) if @$kids;          # base: opaque
      my $key_uctx = $t eq \x27h_acc\x27 ? \x27strkey\x27 : \x27num\x27;
      _tw_walk($ctx, $xo, $_, 0, $key_uctx) for @$kids[1 .. $#$kids];
      return;
    }

The other six access node types -- h_ref_acc, a_ref_acc, slice_h_acc,
slice_a_acc, kv_slice_h_acc, kv_slice_a_acc -- have the SAME [BASE,
SUBSCRIPT...] shape (that is what #995\x27s `%ACCESS_NODE` set records) but fall
through to the generic "recurse with opaque use class" tail, so their
subscripts are classified `opaque`.

MEASURED (s466bd, after #995):

  my $r; for my $n (1..3) { my $k = "k" . $n; $r->{$k}++; }
    B-DEBUG $k unboxable=1 coerce=- strbuf=0 reasons=[] uses={opaque=1}

  the same loop over a plain %h:
    B-DEBUG $k unboxable=1 coerce=- strbuf=0 reasons=[] uses={strkey=1}

`$k` is unboxable in BOTH after #995 -- this is not a correctness bug and not
a boxing bug.  What is lost is the B-regime verdict the use class feeds: a
slot whose every use is `strkey`/`str` can be frozen to a raw STRING
(%pcl-to-string-strict), which is where the s466bd emission A/B saw
`(let (($tid (%pcl-to-string-strict …)))` appear.  A key read through `->{}`
never gets that, although `$r->{$k}` stringifies the key exactly as `$h{$k}`
does.

THE FIX is one line in the classification arm: extend the h_acc/a_acc test to
the whole `%ACCESS_NODE` set with the per-type key class (h_ref_acc /
slice_h_acc / kv_slice_h_acc -> strkey; a_ref_acc / slice_a_acc /
kv_slice_a_acc -> num), keeping the BASE walk opaque (a deref root must stay
opaque -- it is a reference, not a string).  Rule 11: `%ACCESS_NODE` is
already the one place that knows the shape.

BAR: corpus-diff + the 1006-file emission A/B (this WIDENS which slots take a
coercion, so read every diff), the gate, the full sweep, and the arrhash-k
bench row.  A coercion regime freezes a VALUE, so the probes must include a
key that is not a plain string (a number, undef, a reference stringified as a
key) read back through `->{}`.

== RESIDUE ADDED s468 (Fable review of #995 at merge, 2026-09-04) ==
An lvalue substr on an ELEMENT still boxes the key: `my $k = "k".$n; substr($h{$k}, 0, 1) = "x"` gives `$k unboxable=0 reasons=[write-list]` (probed with PCL_B_DEBUG on the merged tree 0e0b0b9), because the `=` arm's LHS root is the substr FUNCALL, not an access node, so `_tw_mark_lvalue` marks the whole subtree.  perl only reads the key.  Same family as this task: a subscript under a non-access root (the lvalue functions substr/vec/pos; `push @{$h{$k}}`, `local $h{$k}` and a foreach alias over an element are already right — probed).  Fix shape: teach `_tw_mark_lvalue` that an lvalue-function root writes its FIRST argument and recurse into that argument as the lvalue.  Perf only, never correctness (over-boxing is the safe direction).


=== DONE, main half (s469bh, 2026-09-05) ===

THE FIX IS THE ONE THE TASK NAMED, spelled through the table rather than
beside it: `%ACCESS_NODE` now maps each of the eight node types to the use
class its SUBSCRIPT position licenses (h_acc / h_ref_acc / slice_h_acc /
kv_slice_h_acc -> 'strkey'; a_acc / a_ref_acc / slice_a_acc / kv_slice_a_acc
-> 'num') instead of to a bare 1, the classification arm in `_tw_walk` tests
`$ACCESS_NODE{$t}` and reads the class from it, and `_tw_mark_lvalue`'s
`while ($ACCESS_NODE{$t})` is unchanged (every value is truthy).  The
declaration moved up beside the other use-class tables, since it now carries
one.  The BASE walk stays opaque, as the task required.

VERIFIED with PCL_B_DEBUG on the task's own reproducer:

  my $r; for my $n (1..3) { my $k = "k" . $n; $r->{$k}++; }
    before: $k unboxable=1 coerce=- uses={opaque=1}
    after:  $k unboxable=1 coerce=- uses={strkey=1}      (= the plain-%h twin)

and on a shape where the freeze actually fires, all five spellings:

  $r->{$k1}      -> ($k1 :str (%pcl-to-string-strict ...))
  @$r{$k2,"z"}   -> ($k2 :str ...)
  %$r{$k3}       -> ($k3 :str ...)
  $ar->[$i1]     -> ($i1 :num (%pcl-to-number-strict ...))
  @$ar[$i2, 0]   -> ($i2 :num ...)

BARS.  Emission over the perl-tests corpus IDENTICAL (111 files, silent drops
5 unchanged) -- so the sweep cannot move, and it was not run (the
WHAT-TO-RUN-WHEN table's first row).  lib A/B 19 SAME / 1 DIFF / 0 RCDIFF;
WIDE A/B 1033 files (20 lib + 595 perl t/ + 312 cpan + 6 shapes) 1027 SAME /
6 DIFF / 0 RCDIFF.  All six diffs are ONE family and each was read: List::Util
(shuffle's `$i`/`$j`; zip/mesh's `my $i = $_` under `$_->[$i]`),
t/re/pat_psycho.t, t/porting/test_testlist.t, Test2's Event.pm ($key =
META_KEY()) and API/Context.pm ($hid), TestML/Tiny.pm ($point_name = $1).
Gate 198/6756 (only the 13 pclxs xs rows).  Generation v2-670, all three
artifacts regenerated -- their bodies come out byte-identical to main's,
which is the corpus result restated.

SIXTEEN PROBES vs perl 5.40.3, every one identical in default AND
PCL_OPT=none mode: a key read through ->{}; @$r{...} and @{$r}{...}; %h{},
%$r{}, %a[] and @$ar[...]; the key slot holding a number / undef / a
reference / an overloaded object; a numeric ->[] index holding "3abc"; the
nested chain $r->{$k}{x}; a key used numerically as well; List::Util's
shuffle/zip/mesh (the lib movers, incl. the determinism assertion under
$List::Util::RAND).  The ONE disagreement is `tie %t` -- an ANNOUNCED
non-support (task #155), pre-existing, and its value half still matches.

AN OVERLOADED `""` CANNOT MEET THE FREEZE AT ALL: `use overload` anywhere in
the FILE turns the whole B regime off ($host->{_overload_in_file} in
_analyze_tree).  That was probed, not assumed.

GUARD Pl/t/lvalue-root-01.t rows 24-30 (plan 23 -> 30), one spelling each plus
two negatives.  Inverse guard c80b1a0: rows 24, 26, 27, 28, 29 fail there;
25 (the deref ROOT stays boxed) and 30 (-raw-numeric) pass on both sides.

WHAT IT WALKED INTO -- the finding of this task.  t/re/pat_psycho.t:55 is
`for (my $i = @psycho; -- $i;)`, and with slice subscripts classified `num`
its `$i` takes the raw verdict -- which HUNG.  `box-set` on a non-box stores
nothing, so a value-consuming `--$i` on a raw slot computed the new value and
threw it away, and the loop never terminated.  PRE-EXISTING on c80b1a0
(reproduced there from the plain `$a[$i]` spelling, whose index has been
`num` for far longer), filed and FIXED as **#1105** in the commit before this
one.  #1056 could not have shipped over it: it makes the hang reachable from
a file that runs today.

Commit: 43fb50e.  Preceded by a96531e (#1105).

RESIDUE STILL OPEN on this task: the s468 review addendum -- an lvalue
`substr($h{$k}, 0, 1) = "x"` still boxes the key, because the `=` arm's LHS
root is the substr FUNCALL, not an access node, so `_tw_mark_lvalue` marks
the whole subtree.  Not touched here.
subject: PERF (residue of #995): a subscript under a DEREF or SLICE access is classified opaque, so its raw slot cannot take a B-regime coercion
